grade.name: UKG
grade.description: Upper Kindergarten curriculum for ages 5-6. English builds advanced vowel families (Short A, E, I, O, U) into sentence, paragraph, and story reading with comprehension and independent writing for Grade-1 readiness. Includes phonemic awareness, nonsense word decoding, delayed grammar, and structured writing progression. Maths reaches 300 with tables, addition, subtraction, and skip counting. Hindi advances all matras with complete units (recognition, word building, reading, writing, speaking, sentence reading, sentence writing, assessment) into paragraph and story comprehension. Includes EVS and school-etiquette themes.
